items.alt: The booth before dawn. Ray, the lead engineer, welcomes Maya — a new volunteer on her first Sunday on headset.

bubbles.text: Welcome to the booth. First rule — forget everything you know about “gear.”

items.alt: Four colored lines — signal, power, control, network — flow through the booth between Ray and Maya.

bubbles.text: You're not fixing toys. You're reading a system — signal, power, control, network. Pull one thread and the rest feels it.
So today I learn to think like an engineer.

items.text: FIELD NOTE —  Four paths run through every system: signal, power, control, and network. A confident tech always asks which one just broke, before touching a single cable.
